name: Chiswick
description: Sell your broken supercar in Chiswick. Gearbox faults, engine problems and non-runners assessed, with free collection once the sale and access are agreed.
hero: A transmission warning or a car that will not select a gear can make a private sale difficult to arrange. Tell us about your Chiswick supercar and request a valuation with the fault unresolved.
introTitle: Describe the gearbox problem without guessing the diagnosis
intro: “Reverse will not engage” gives a buyer different information from “a specialist has confirmed internal gearbox damage”. Share the exact symptoms, warning messages and any diagnostic findings. If the cause remains unknown, make that clear.

We consider Porsche, Ferrari, McLaren, Lamborghini and other specialist vehicles with mechanical faults or damage in Chiswick. The assessment also considers the rest of the car: model, mileage, history, bodywork and any previous repair work.

Our Greater London service includes Chiswick, Turnham Green, Grove Park and Strand-on-the-Green. If the car is in managed parking or at a workshop elsewhere, use that actual address. We plan collection around the vehicle rather than expecting you to drive it to us.
collectionTitle: Loading a Chiswick car that cannot drive
collectionIntro: Tell us whether the fault affects neutral selection, steering or the parking brake before a collection is agreed.

collection.title: Unable to select neutral
collection.body: Give the model and current symptoms to the collection team. Do not force the selector or attempt a release procedure without appropriate model-specific advice.

collection.title: Basement or managed parking
collection.body: Describe ramps, height limits, barriers and the route to the space. If you need permission from a building manager for access, arrange that before the collection date.

collection.title: Roadside or workshop access
collection.body: Explain where a transporter can approach the car and mention any known access or loading restrictions. The operator needs the real location, not just the nearest main road.

coverageIntro: Chiswick enquiries sit within our Greater London collection service. The following areas describe coverage, not business premises.

areas.title: Chiswick and Turnham Green
areas.body: Tell us the postcode and whether the vehicle is on a drive, in a garage or at a commercial site.

areas.title: Grove Park and Strand-on-the-Green
areas.body: Include entrance details and photographs of the parking position. If the car is held elsewhere for repairs, give that location instead.

preparationTitle: What helps assess a transmission fault

preparation.title: The exact report
preparation.body: Keep fault codes and the workshop’s written findings if available. A replacement quotation and a confirmed diagnosis are not necessarily the same thing.

preparation.title: The car’s behaviour
preparation.body: Describe whether the fault is intermittent and when it occurs. Do not arrange a road test solely to reproduce a serious warning for a buyer.

preparation.title: The proposed repair
preparation.body: If you have an estimate, explain what it includes and whether work has begun. You can compare it with an as-is offer before authorising further expenditure.

closing: Request a valuation for your Chiswick supercar with its registration, mileage and known gearbox or other faults. We’ll confirm what further information is needed and discuss collection access.

faqs.question: Can I sell a Porsche with a PDK fault in Chiswick?
faqs.answer: You can request an assessment with a PDK fault. Include the exact warning, symptoms and any specialist report; do not assume every warning requires a complete gearbox replacement.

faqs.question: Can collection be arranged from underground parking?
faqs.answer: It depends on the vehicle and access. Provide ramp, height and barrier details so the collection team can assess the equipment and arrangements needed before confirming.

faqs.question: What if the car cannot select neutral?
faqs.answer: Tell us at the start of the enquiry. That affects loading and must be planned for. Do not try to force the gearbox into neutral just to prepare for collection.
